## About
Factory Direct Remodeling of Atlanta works out of an office on McCollum Parkway in Kennesaw and builds for homeowners across the greater Atlanta area. Bringing the outdoors in is the whole idea: sunrooms, screen rooms, patio covers, pergolas and under decking, plus windows, siding and gutters.
Michael, the owner, is the one reviewers mention coming out to quote their projects. Rick, our GM, estimates and designs work too, and our installers are factory-trained and work exclusively for us. We also keep a full-time field expeditor who helps guide your project from the beginning until you're completely satisfied.
Our materials are assembled in the USA, and we don't cut corners. Some of our neighbors come back for a second project, like a patio cover that later becomes an enclosed room.

## Services
- New Replacement Windows: Custom-built, insulated, double pane vinyl replacement windows in a variety of styles and colors.
- Sunroom Installation: Sunrooms you can enjoy in the winter and the hot summer months.
- Screen Rooms: Screened porches, screened patio enclosures and screened-in decks.
- Patio Covers: Vinyl, aluminum and wood patio covers that keep the blinding sun off your patio table.
- Ultra Lattice Pergolas: Ultra Lattice pergolas and patio cover combinations for your backyard.
- Under Decking: Waterproof under decking, screened under decking and under decking sunrooms to use the space below your deck.
- Vinyl Siding: Vinyl siding, plus James Hardie Plank Siding.
- Gutter Guard Systems: Color-coordinated, seamless gutter systems.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: From our office in Kennesaw, our staff works with homeowners within a 120-mile-plus radius of Atlanta, including Marietta, Roswell, Alpharetta, Cumming, Canton, Smyrna and Acworth.

Q: Is the estimate free?
A: Yes. Call us or fill out the contact form for a free estimate.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes, we have a full line of financing options.

Q: Can you help with my HOA approval?
A: One reviewer said Dee put together a mock up of their screened-in deck for their HOA modification request, which helped them get a quick approval.
